findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: This clause transfers ownership of the work to the client the moment it is delivered, which occurs prior to payment under Net 30 terms. If the client fails to pay, you have already lost ownership and leverage.
findings.suggested_change: Amend the clause to condition the transfer of intellectual property rights upon receipt of full payment for the respective Deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I am looking forward to our project and have one small note on the agreement. - In the relevant clause, intellectual property rights transfer upon delivery prior to full payment. I propose amending the agreement to condition the transfer of these rights upon receipt of full payment for the respective deliverables. Let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
